CRASH_RECOVERY: Readonly reconcile only; no claim deletion, reset, replay or launch-capability reconstitution
DIRECTORY_FSYNC: After new directory entry publication before launch
EVIDENCE_RETENTION: Claims and final evidence survive restart/failure; archiving/deletion needs separate authority and cannot reopen grant
FILESYSTEM_TYPE: Exact local filesystem/device/mount profile unbound; owner reports ext4, no actual store profile supplied
FILE_FSYNC: After complete finite claim publication before launch
INDEPENDENT_FS_GUARANTEES: Unverified; no power-loss durability claim from fsync API alone
INDEPENDENT_REREAD: Independent readonly descriptor confirms raw/canonical hash, grant/key, inode/type/ownership and complete required fields
PARTIAL_RECORD_POLICY: Permanent ambiguous consumed anchor, zero launch/retry. No stale-lock removal or identical-record success.
REVOCATION: Fresh exact effective grant/lifecycle before claim and immediately before invocation; revoked/expired/unknown cancels launch without refund

STORE_PERMISSIONS.ANCESTORS: trusted non-writable to unauthorized callers; no symlink, ownership/mount identity exact

STORE_ROOT_RULE_ORIGIN: Exact Package102 prospective path, not created or authorized here
